list.name: search
list.label: Search
list.description: Whitespace/punctuation-separated words, matched case-insensitively against the message text (e.g. failed password). Empty = no text filter.

list.name: mode
list.label: Match
list.description: all words must appear (hasAllTokens) or any one word (hasAnyTokens).

list.name: host
list.label: Host
list.description: Linux host, Windows computer, Kubernetes node or AWS account id. Values are hex-encoded so any name is safe to splice into SQL.
list.definition: SELECT hex(host) AS value, host AS text FROM siem.log_search WHERE $__timeFilter(event_time) AND $__conditionalAll(has(splitByChar(',', trim(BOTH '{}' FROM decodeURLComponent('${source:percentencode}'))), source), $source) GROUP BY host ORDER BY host LIMIT 1000

query.rawSql: SELECT hex(host) AS value, host AS text FROM siem.log_search WHERE $__timeFilter(event_time) AND $__conditionalAll(has(splitByChar(',', trim(BOTH '{}' FROM decodeURLComponent('${source:percentencode}'))), source), $source) GROUP BY host ORDER BY host LIMIT 1000

list.name: user
list.label: User
list.description: Linux/Windows user name or CloudTrail principal ARN (top 1000 by volume). Kubernetes and GuardDuty rows have no user and only match when User is All.
list.definition: SELECT hex(user) AS value, user AS text FROM siem.log_search WHERE user != '' AND $__timeFilter(event_time) AND $__conditionalAll(has(splitByChar(',', trim(BOTH '{}' FROM decodeURLComponent('${source:percentencode}'))), source), $source) GROUP BY user ORDER BY count() DESC LIMIT 1000

query.rawSql: SELECT hex(user) AS value, user AS text FROM siem.log_search WHERE user != '' AND $__timeFilter(event_time) AND $__conditionalAll(has(splitByChar(',', trim(BOTH '{}' FROM decodeURLComponent('${source:percentencode}'))), source), $source) GROUP BY user ORDER BY count() DESC LIMIT 1000

panels.title: Log volume by source
panels.description: Events matching the filters above, bucketed to the panel width. Searches are one query over siem.log_search (clickhouse/ddl/050_search.sql).

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeInterval(event_time) AS time, source, count() AS events FROM siem.log_search WHERE $__timeFilter(event_time) AND $__conditionalAll(has(splitByChar(',', trim(BOTH '{}' FROM decodeURLComponent('${source:percentencode}'))), source), $source) AND $__conditionalAll(has(arrayMap(x -> unhex(x), splitByChar(',', trim(BOTH '{}' FROM decodeURLComponent('${host:percentencode}')))), host), $host) AND $__conditionalAll(has(arrayMap(x -> unhex(x), splitByChar(',', trim(BOTH '{}' FROM decodeURLComponent('${user:percentencode}')))), user), $user) AND (decodeURLComponent('${search:percentencode}') = '' OR (hasAnyTokens(search_text, lower(decodeURLComponent('${search:percentencode}'))) AND (decodeURLComponent('${mode:percentencode}') = 'any' OR hasAllTokens(search_text, lower(decodeURLComponent('${search:percentencode}')))))) GROUP BY time, source ORDER BY time

panels.title: Matching logs
panels.description: Newest 500 matches. Expand a row and use Show context for the surrounding lines from the same source and host.

targets.rawSql: SELECT event_time AS timestamp, message AS body, level, source, host, user, origin FROM siem.log_search WHERE $__timeFilter(event_time) AND $__conditionalAll(has(splitByChar(',', trim(BOTH '{}' FROM decodeURLComponent('${source:percentencode}'))), source), $source) AND $__conditionalAll(has(arrayMap(x -> unhex(x), splitByChar(',', trim(BOTH '{}' FROM decodeURLComponent('${host:percentencode}')))), host), $host) AND $__conditionalAll(has(arrayMap(x -> unhex(x), splitByChar(',', trim(BOTH '{}' FROM decodeURLComponent('${user:percentencode}')))), user), $user) AND (decodeURLComponent('${search:percentencode}') = '' OR (hasAnyTokens(search_text, lower(decodeURLComponent('${search:percentencode}'))) AND (decodeURLComponent('${mode:percentencode}') = 'any' OR hasAllTokens(search_text, lower(decodeURLComponent('${search:percentencode}')))))) ORDER BY event_time DESC LIMIT 500

panels.title: Matching events (table)
panels.description: Newest 200 matches with every common column. Column filters apply to this table only.

targets.rawSql: SELECT event_time, source, origin, host, user, level, message FROM siem.log_search WHERE $__timeFilter(event_time) AND $__conditionalAll(has(splitByChar(',', trim(BOTH '{}' FROM decodeURLComponent('${source:percentencode}'))), source), $source) AND $__conditionalAll(has(arrayMap(x -> unhex(x), splitByChar(',', trim(BOTH '{}' FROM decodeURLComponent('${host:percentencode}')))), host), $host) AND $__conditionalAll(has(arrayMap(x -> unhex(x), splitByChar(',', trim(BOTH '{}' FROM decodeURLComponent('${user:percentencode}')))), user), $user) AND (decodeURLComponent('${search:percentencode}') = '' OR (hasAnyTokens(search_text, lower(decodeURLComponent('${search:percentencode}'))) AND (decodeURLComponent('${mode:percentencode}') = 'any' OR hasAllTokens(search_text, lower(decodeURLComponent('${search:percentencode}')))))) ORDER BY event_time DESC LIMIT 200
